title: lint: os validate / os build refuse a report that reads a dataset its declared dependency holds (chart-dataset-unknown reads stack.datasets alone), while the runtime serves it — report half of #32967
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location. This is work that #32967 named and PR #33121 does not carry; it was carried to triage by `epic:#31527#2` (6857990387) from review#1's boundary flag on PR #33121 (6857932402).

## What happens

#32967 makes authoring resolve a dataset reader through the reader's declared closure, as the runtime does. Its summary names dashboards, reports and joined blocks. PR #33121 fixes **dashboards** only.

For **reports**, `chart-dataset-unknown` (`packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts`) still reads `stack.datasets` alone. On the per-package pass, a report that reads a dataset held by a package it **declares as a dependency** is refused by `os validate` / `os build`, while the runtime serves that report. So authoring is stricter than the runtime, and a valid package will not build.

Disposed without a card, by the epic seat on review#1's measurement: card item 2 (an app action starting a module flow). Neither side refuses it there, so authoring and runtime agree for flows.

## Why it matters

An app built from modules (the #32929 shape) cannot build a report on a sibling module's dataset, even though it would work at runtime. The refusal is wrong, so its remedy text cannot help.

## Do

- Resolve a report's dataset through the report's declaring package's closure: own datasets, then declared dependencies, refusing two holders. Use the same resolver PR #33121 uses for dashboards (`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`).
- Then re-judge `validate-report-runtime-filter.ts` (it reads the same index; review nit N1 on PR #33121).
- Pins: a report over a declared dependency's dataset passes; over an undeclared one it is refused; over two holders it is refused naming both.

## Reader

`domain:server`, the same lane as #32967. `packages/lint` is anchored to spec, but the parent and its resolver sit in server's PR.

## Dedupe

`chart-dataset-unknown`: 0 open framework cards (only #32929 and #32967 as context). `report dataset declared dependency`: none.
